responsibility: This definition file lists the generic HSA offloading builtins that GCC exposes outside the normal builtins.def path, primarily so front ends such as Fortran can share them. It declares the builtin enum names, external function names, type signatures, and attributes for basic workgroup/workitem/grid query operations used by HSA/OpenMP offloading support. Its role is a small declarative builtin catalogue separate from the richer BRIG opcode-oriented builtin tables in brig-builtins.def.
